finite_premise_reuse.why_exact: The expected composer premise universally quantifies implicit n plus Model n/hDVR/hRF. Expected-type inference supplies that implicit n; the lambda retains then ignores only hRF. The result uses the identical M.K, Place, hDVR-dependent ramIdx and coordinate M.u. mathematical_checks.detail: Place M.K is the existing subtype of every proper valuation subring containing ℚ. It includes places at infinity and is not an affine chart or Qbar-point sample. Every support set and coefficient quantifier uses exactly this Place M.K.

ramIdx is the actual integer ord of the residue minimal polynomial at a regular place and minus ord of M.u at a pole. noncriticalRamificationPositive supplies 0<ramIdx for the same M/hDVR/u/P using M.transcendental_u. Thus for a regular place with nonzero e-1, omega derives 1<e. No natural-number truncation or positivity assumption is inserted.

The local instance IsCurveField M.K := M.isCurveField is derived from the existing model. Place.finite_setOf_notMem M.u gives finite actual poles. The same field/Place carrier is used by hRam. No arbitrary support or omitted infinity branch is substituted.

For P in support of the coefficient function, if M.u∉P.1 it belongs to the finite pole set. If M.u∈P.1, support membership rewrites to e-1≠0; actual e>0 yields e>1, putting P in the ramification set. Hence support⊆poles∪ramification. Poles with e=1 still have coefficient -2 and are correctly retained by the pole branch.

Finsupp.ofSupportFinite wraps exactly the existing branch function. coordinateCanonicalDivisor_apply is rfl. coordinateCanonicalData.D is that actual finite divisor and coefficient is definitionally the original if expression. No degree-only divisor, chosen coefficient field, residue-degree substitution or arbitrary rational differential is supplied.

Model N.K is an IntermediateField in fixed Ω=AlgebraicClosure(RatFunc ℚ), so the source functions all use the same fixed model universe. Place supports Type* and Divisor M fixes Place M.K→₀ℤ. Composer quantifies n:ℕ, not a distinct universe. The expected-type lambda specializes the generic theorem with no universe lift. Exact elaboration remains for MCP-CI.
